The '''''Bloodshield''''' was a legendary [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] that was ancient by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the adoption of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] classification scheme known as the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. The vessel was used by the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]], which, together with its allies, waged a series of wars known as the [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|Alsakan Conflicts]] between [[17,018 BBY]] and [[3017 BBY]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Some military [[Historian/Legends|historians]] insisted that, under the Anaxes War College System, the ''Bloodshield'' would fall into the capital ship category known as [[Battlecruiser/Legends|battlecruisers]], which were generally between two and five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long. Most historians, however, agreed that the earliest [[Warship/Legends|warship]] model qualifying for that category was instead the twenty-five-hundred-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] [[Procurator-class Star Battlecruiser|''Procurator''-class Star Battlecruiser]], which was developed two [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] before the Clone Wars.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Bloodshield'' was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" />
